title: Bar Hinak
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Pesachim 101b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.101b.2-3) Rav Idi bar Avin said to Rav Chisda: “So we learned it in the baraita of the school of Rav Hinak — and some say, in the baraita of the school of Bar Hinak.”[^1]

notes.text: The first paragraph identifies Rav Chisda as Rav Idi bar Avin’s addressee. The next gives Rav Hinak and Bar Hinak as alternatives. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1031&lang=en) preserves the alternatives and leaves open whether Hinak was a Tanna or an Amora.
